swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM27313XMF/NOPB uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV) while TPS61200DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (SW vs BYPASS), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (FB vs SW), Pin 4 (EN vs GND), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs OTHER), Pin 8 (NONE vs PS), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Soldering TPS61200DRCR onto a LM27313XMF/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-23-5: NONE vs VSON-10: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
HIGH RECTIFICATION DIFFERENCE: LM27313XMF/NOPB is non-synchronous and requires an external Schottky catch/freewheeling diode, whereas the counterpart integrates a synchronous low-side MOSFET.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (LM27313XMF/NOPB: 10 µH p.1 vs TPS61200DRCR: 2.2 µH p.15); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (LM27313XMF/NOPB: 1.23 V p.5 vs TPS61200DRCR: 0.5 V p.6); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (LM27313XMF/NOPB: 14 V p.4 vs TPS61200DRCR: 5.5 V p.5); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: LM27313XMF/NOPB specifies 800 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS61200DRCR 1350 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.6). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 75% (LM27313XMF/NOPB: 166.3 °C/W p.4 vs TPS61200DRCR: 41.2 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: LM27313XMF/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS61200DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (SW vs BYPASS), Pin 2 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 3 (FB vs SW), Pin 4 (EN vs GND), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs OTHER), Pin 8 (NONE vs PS), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (non-sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency is 1600 kHz (p.5) vs 1450 kHz (p.6), rated current is 800 mA (p.5) vs 1350 mA (p.6), typical inductor is 10 µH (p.1) vs 2.2 µH (p.15), and Iq is 400 µA (p.5) vs 55 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.4), thermal margin (θJA 166.3 vs 41.2 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
